note.title: Morning Functional Triplet
note.rawContent:
# Morning Functional Triplet

Active recovery and capacity work before heavy afternoon squatting.
Focus on smooth transitions and steady breathing.

```time
5 Rounds
  15 Kettlebell Swings 24 kg
  12 Push-ups
  9 Box Jumps 24 in
  *:45 Rest
```

## Mobility Post-Workout
- 2:00 Couch Stretch per side
- 1:00 Pigeon Pose
